text:
maria: Hey @eng-runtime — we need a quick rerun and a reproducibility checklist for the webinar demo next Wed. goal: publish a blog + run a 15-min live demo. Can you reproduce the quantized 70B numbers we showed in the deck and dump raw traces? :rocket:

samir: Got it. Which dataset/cohort and hardware profile should we target?

maria: Primary: "webinar-cohort-v2" (mix of chat and long-context prompts). Hardware: dedicated gpunode-rt-4 (A100-like) and a fallback on cpu-quantized-small for the demo fallback. We need p50/p95/p99, coldstart heatmap, and a sampleset of token traces.

ryan: Also want a short methodology blurb we can paste into the blog: warmup policy, batch sizes, KV cache settings, quantization bits. Keep it <6 bullets.

samir: OK. Planning: 1) cold start sweep (0->100 concurrent), 2) steady-state throughput sweep, 3) tail latency probes with synthetic noisy inputs. We'll capture KV cache hit rates and batching distribution. Anything else?

maria: Please include fallback routing timings (time to failover to cpu quantized) and a short note on determinism for identical inputs (we need to confirm seeds/kv cache resets).

engbot: automated-run started: run_id=webinar-1827654321-01. ETA ~35m. Artifacts will land in s3://redwood-bench/webinar/webinar-1827654321/ with manifest.json.

laura: Heads-up for schedule: marketing needs the artifacts and methodology doc by EOD day -2 before webinar to assemble slides. Is that feasible?

samir: EOD day -2 is tight but doable if we scope to a curated subset (200 sample traces + aggregated metrics). Full trace dump will take longer.

nisha: Can you include seed and config snippet in the manifest? We need to show how to re-run one of the p99 tail cases during the live demo.

samir: will include. example config we plan to commit: ```json
{
  "model": "llama-70b-q4_0",
  "batch_size": 8,
  "warmup_requests": 10,
  "kv_cache_reset": true,
  "quant_bits": 4
}
```

ryan: Quick QA ask: add a small AB run comparing q4_0 vs q5_0 (same traffic) so we can make a measured claim about quality vs perf. No need to run full sweep for both, just the 200-sample cohort.

samir: adding AB sample. That will add ~12m. still within ETA?

engbot: run update: added ab_probe (q4_0 vs q5_0). new ETA ~50m. progress: 20% complete.

maria: Amazing — please tag artifacts with `for-blog` and `for-demo` and upload a one-paragraph methodology.md we can link to from the post. Keep the methodology short and explicit about warmup and batching.

samir: Will do. Checklist I'll include in methodology.md: 1) dataset shard and RNG seed; 2) hardware spec; 3) warmup policy and steady-state window; 4) batching config; 5) KV cache handling; 6) AB comparison sample size; 7) how to reproduce a p99 trace (command).

nisha: For the reproduce command, please give the exact CLI snippet. Example: `rt-bench replay --run webinar-1827654321-01 --case p99-idx-42 --target gpunode-rt-4`

samir: noted. We'll include that exact line and the env vars.

engbot: run complete. artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/webinar/webinar-1827654321/manifest.json (contains p50/p95/p99 CSVs, heatmaps, 200-sample-traces.tar.gz, ab_probe_summary.json). checksum: sha256:abc123...

laura: thanks! marketing will grab the 200-sample-traces + methodology.md and draft the blog. Can we get a short one-liner from runtime about limitations (e.g., "numbers are for this cohort/hardware, your mileage may vary")?

samir: Sure: "Numbers reflect the webinar-cohort-v2 workload on the specified hardware; results will vary with prompt distribution, sequence length, and deployment config. See methodology.md to reproduce."

maria: Perfect. Last ask: can we keep a small reproducibility badge in the blog with a link to the manifest? Something like "Reproducible artifacts available" -> s3 link or internal page.

ryan: Also confirm no sensitive data in traces. Are the traces sanitized?

samir: yes sanitized. we stripped PII and replaced user tokens with placeholders. manifest includes scrub log.

maria: Great — thanks everyone :thumbsup: We'll queue content work once artifacts are live.

nisha: adding a note to the handoff doc: inbound leads from the webinar should be routed to demo@redwood.com and assigned to AE queue 2.

maria: Noted. We'll wire that into the registration flow. Thanks team! :sparkles:
